notes: Contraction of 'each face of a regular octahedron is an equilateral triangle'. The related question (how many edges a regular octahedron has) is arithmetic over the eight faces and the number of sides of each. The interior angle of a face is the angle of its shape, by a rule.

bridge_refs.acute: Every equilateral triangle is an acute triangle.
bridge_refs.angle: Each interior angle of an equilateral triangle measures 60 degrees.
